# Local derivative inputs

The generated ABI15 parser is unchanged. The active scanner consumes nested comment delimiters fully, checks1024depth, and charges external work under sticky same-thread request status. The complete upstream remains under upstream/. The Rust owned-Rc bridge derives from the existing Pug wrapper; allocation remains MemoryEnforcement::Unavailable. Build compiles only retained local C inputs and never runs a generator or downloads code.

Wrapper-body identity hashes bindings/rust/lib.rs after replacing the entire SCANNER_CONTRACT_IDENTITY declaration with the literal declaration containing ROOTLIGHT_SCANNER_IDENTITY.
